question: Which city in India is known as the 'Detroit of India' due to its automobile industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chennai** is known as the **"Detroit of India"** because it is home to a large number of** automobile manufacturing companies**. 
 
• Some of the major automobile companies in Chennai include** Hyundai, Ford, BMW, and Renault-Nissan**.
 
• Chennai's automotive industry is one of the** largest** in India and has been growing rapidly over the past few decades.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mumbai** is also known as the **financial capital** of India.

 
 
• It is home to several major industries such as** finance, entertainment, and textiles.**
 
 
 
• **Bengaluru **is also known as the** "Silicon Valley of India,"**.
 
 
• It is known for its technology industry and is home to several major tech companies such as **Infosys, Wipro, and Dell.**
 
 
 
• **Pune** is located in the western state of **Maharashtra.**
 
 
• It is known for its manufacturing industry and is home to several automobile companies such as **Tata Motors and Mahindra.**
